arguments.query: SELECT name, sql FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = 'table'

SELECT 'booking' AS kind, json_object('booking_id',booking_id,'request_id',request_id,'flight_id',flight_id,'passenger_id',passenger_id,'amount_cents',amount_cents,'status',status,'client_reference',client_reference) AS data FROM bookings WHERE status='pending'
UNION ALL SELECT 'charge',json_object('charge_id',c.charge_id,'booking_id',c.booking_id,'key',c.idempotency_key,'amount',c.amount_cents,'state',c.state,'step',c.created_step) FROM charges c JOIN bookings b USING(booking_id) WHERE b.status='pending'
UNION ALL SELECT 'customer_event',json_object('event_id',event_id,'request_id',request_id,'kind',kind,'step',step) FROM customer_events
UNION ALL SELECT 'outbox',json_object('event_id',event_id,'booking_id',booking_id,'payload',payload,'status',status,'attempts',attempts) FROM outbox WHERE status='pending'
UNION ALL SELECT 'flight',json_object('flight_id',flight_id,'capacity',capacity,'price',price_cents,'version',version) FROM flights
UNION ALL SELECT 'cache',json_object('key',key,'value',value) FROM cache
UNION ALL SELECT 'fare_hold',json_object('hold_id',hold_id,'flight_id',flight_id,'price',price_cents,'until_step',until_step) FROM fare_holds
UNION ALL SELECT 'config',json_object('service',service,'value',value) FROM service_config

SELECT 'booking' kind,json_object('booking_id',b.booking_id,'request_id',b.request_id,'flight_id',b.flight_id,'passenger_id',b.passenger_id,'amount',b.amount_cents,'status',b.status,'client_reference',b.client_reference,'charge_id',c.charge_id,'key',c.idempotency_key,'charge_state',c.state,'charge_step',c.created_step,'cancel_event',e.event_id) data FROM bookings b LEFT JOIN charges c USING(booking_id) LEFT JOIN customer_events e ON e.request_id=b.request_id WHERE b.status!='confirmed'
UNION ALL SELECT 'customer_event',json_object('event_id',event_id,'request_id',request_id,'kind',kind,'step',step) FROM customer_events
UNION ALL SELECT 'refund',json_object('booking_id',booking_id,'charge_id',charge_id,'amount',amount_cents) FROM refunds
UNION ALL SELECT 'config',json_object('service',service,'value',value) FROM service_config

SELECT 'pending_bookings' AS check_name,count(*) AS issues FROM bookings WHERE status='pending'
UNION ALL SELECT 'oversold_flights',count(*) FROM (SELECT h.flight_id FROM holds h JOIN flights f USING(flight_id) GROUP BY h.flight_id HAVING count(*)>max(f.capacity))
UNION ALL SELECT 'unbacked_confirmations',count(*) FROM bookings b WHERE b.status='confirmed' AND (NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM holds h WHERE h.booking_id=b.booking_id AND h.flight_id=b.flight_id AND h.passenger_id=b.passenger_id) OR (SELECT count(*) FROM charges c WHERE c.booking_id=b.booking_id AND c.state='captured' AND c.amount_cents=b.amount_cents)!=1)
UNION ALL SELECT 'missing_or_mismatched_checkins',count(*) FROM bookings b WHERE b.status='confirmed' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM checkins c WHERE c.booking_id=b.booking_id AND c.flight_id=b.flight_id AND c.passenger_id=b.passenger_id)
UNION ALL SELECT 'ineligible_checkins',count(*) FROM checkins c LEFT JOIN bookings b USING(booking_id) WHERE b.booking_id IS NULL OR b.status!='confirmed' OR b.flight_id!=c.flight_id OR b.passenger_id!=c.passenger_id
UNION ALL SELECT 'duplicate_sales',count(*) FROM (SELECT client_reference FROM bookings WHERE status='confirmed' AND client_reference IS NOT NULL GROUP BY client_reference HAVING count(*)>1)
UNION ALL SELECT 'cancelled_still_backed',count(*) FROM bookings b WHERE b.status='cancelled' AND (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM holds h WHERE h.booking_id=b.booking_id) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM checkins c WHERE c.booking_id=b.booking_id))
UNION ALL SELECT 'cancelled_captures_without_refund',count(*) FROM bookings b JOIN charges c USING(booking_id) WHERE b.status='cancelled' AND c.state='captured' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM refunds r WHERE r.booking_id=b.booking_id AND r.charge_id=c.charge_id AND r.amount_cents=c.amount_cents)
UNION ALL SELECT 'cancel_requested_but_confirmed',count(*) FROM customer_events e JOIN bookings b USING(request_id) WHERE b.status='confirmed'
UNION ALL SELECT 'pending_outbox',count(*) FROM outbox WHERE status='pending'
UNION ALL SELECT 'confirmed_missing_delivered_event',count(*) FROM bookings b WHERE b.status='confirmed' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM outbox o WHERE o.booking_id=b.booking_id AND o.status='delivered')
UNION ALL SELECT 'invalid_holds',count(*) FROM holds h LEFT JOIN bookings b USING(booking_id) WHERE b.booking_id IS NULL OR b.flight_id!=h.flight_id OR b.passenger_id!=h.passenger_id
UNION ALL SELECT 'orphan_charges',count(*) FROM charges c LEFT JOIN bookings b USING(booking_id) WHERE b.booking_id IS NULL
UNION ALL SELECT 'unwarranted_refunds',count(*) FROM refunds r LEFT JOIN bookings b USING(booking_id) WHERE b.booking_id IS NULL OR b.status='confirmed'
